subject: Next steps: Marketplace integration demo & technical deep-dive
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Anita Shah <anita.shah@nimbusbridge.com>, NimbusBridge Marketplace Team <marketplace@nimbusbridge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: Marketplace integration demo & technical deep-dive

Hi Anita / NimbusBridge team,

Thanks again for taking the time today — appreciate the broad overview and the use cases you outlined for your customers (managed SaaS customers + mid-market migrations). Quick recap and proposal for next steps so we keep momentum: 

Recap (from our side):
- You’re evaluating marketplace listings + private offer flow for enterprise accounts.
- Key technical items: VPC peering for private images, SSO for billing owners, and usage metrics export.
- Timeline: Q2 pilot target, broader availability in Q3 if the pilot goes well.

Proposed next steps:
1) 30-min partner-led demo (high-level marketplace flow + Nexus/Nimbus console walkthrough) — Nimbus to lead; Redwood to provide integration checklist.
2) 60-min technical deep-dive (Redwood infra + devops) — demo of API, deployment models (Hosted vs Dedicated), and how we surface usage to your billing pipeline.
3) Share a Mutual Action Plan (attached) and proposed dates.

Can you confirm who from your side will take the demo vs the technical deep-dive? Below are a few time windows we have open next week (all PST):
- Wed 3/11: 10:00–11:00 or 14:00–15:00
- Thu 3/12: 09:00–10:00 or 16:00–17:00

If those don’t work, send a couple of preferred slots and I’ll align our engineers. I attached a short onboarding doc and a draft MPA for your review.

Agenda suggestion for the deep-dive (60 min):
- 10m: Introductions + goals
- 25m: Architecture & integration patterns (routing, billing hooks, SSO, VPC)
- 15m: Q&A + next steps
- 10m: Action items & owners

Thanks — happy to coordinate calendar invites once you confirm a slot and attendees.

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Senior Partner Manager | Redwood Inference
sergio@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0132
Redwood Inference

Attachments: nimbus-marketplace-onboarding.pdf, redwood-mmp-mpa-v1.docx

From: Anita Shah <anita.shah@nimbusbridge.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Cc: Marco Li <marco.li@nimbusbridge.com>, NimbusBridge Marketplace Team <marketplace@nimbusbridge.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: Marketplace integration demo & technical deep-dive

Hi Sergio — thanks for the clear recap. We’re excited to move forward.

Quick answers:
- I’ll take the partner-led demo (high level). Marco (cc’d) will lead the technical deep-dive — he’s our integrations lead.
- Proposed slot for the demo: Wed 3/11 14:00 PST (we can do 30m). If that’s confirmed, Marco and I will block 60m on Thu 3/12 at 16:00 PST for the deep-dive.

Two quick asks for the technical session:
1) Can you include a short section on KV cache behavior and recommended TTLs for marketplace workloads?
2) We’ll want an export sample for usage metrics (JSON schema) prior to the deep-dive so our billing team can review.

I reviewed the attached MPA at a glance — we’ll send edits.

Best,
Anita Shah
Head of Partnerships | NimbusBridge
anita.shah@nimbusbridge.com | +1 646-555-0899

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 10:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: Marketplace integration demo & technical deep-dive

Sergio — quick internal sync.

I can lead the deep-dive with Marco (he’ll want low-level perf numbers). Laura can open with the product overview and handle the MPA edits live. For the KV cache and TTLs I’ll prep a short one-pager and a sample usage export (JSON) — should have that by EOD Thu (3/12).

Also: do we want to surface our Dedicated vs Hosted cost delta for marketplace-listed units? Might be relevant for the billing team.

Marissa

marissa@redwood.com
